mapper.select: select T4.INSTITUTION_CODE institutionCode, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.CDATE cdate, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.FINPROD_ID finprodId, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.CCY ccy, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.SHARE_AMT shareAmt, nvl(weight.RISK_WEIGHT,1) * (nvl(PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.MARKET_VALUE,0)+nvl(PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_INTINCEXP,0)-nvl(T5.dscCostAmt,0)) dscCostAmt, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.DSC_CLEAN_PRICE dscCleanPrice, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.BUY_COST_AMT buyCostAmt, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.BUY_CLEAN_PRICE buyCleanPrice, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.MARKET_VALUE,0 marketValue, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.MARKET_CLEAN_PRICE marketCleanPrice, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_INTINCEXP,0 tdyIntincexp, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_DSCINCEXP_ADD tdy_dscincexpAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_INTINCEXP_ADD tdyIntincexpAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_DSCLOSS_ADD tdy_dsclossAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL_ADD tdyFloatIngplAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_FEE_ADD tdyFeeAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.ACCU_NET_VALUE accuNetValue, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.SUB_CODE subCode, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.ZGPLAN_ID zgplanId, decode(T2.Type_8,'${fzq}',T1.ISSUER,'${fck}',T1.ISSUER,'${fxml}',T1.FINANCIER, '${gp}',T1.ISSUER,T1.MANAGER) organId, decode(T2.Type_8,'${gp}',T2.TYPE_8,'${zqjz}',T2.TYPE_8,'${whjq}' ,T2.TYPE_8,'${whyq}',T2.TYPE_8,'${whdq}',T2.TYPE_8,T2.TYPE_6) varietyType1, T2.TYPE_7 varietyType2, T2.TYPE_8 assetType from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION LEFT JOIN ( select SUM(nvl(DSC_COST_AMT,0)+nvl(TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)+nvl(TDY_INTINCEXP,0)+ nvl(DELAY_PAY_AMT,0)) dscCostAmt, CDATE,PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID from PTL_SEC_VALUTION GROUP BY CDATE,PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID ) T5 ON T5.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.FINPROD_ID AND T5.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T5.CDATE = PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.CDATE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T1 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_DEPARTMENT T4 ON T4.DEPT_CODE = T3.CREATE_DEPT left join ( SELECT ASSET_TYPE_ONE, ASSET_TYPE_TWO, RISK_WEIGHT FROM ( SELECT ASSET_TYPE_ONE, ASSET_TYPE_TWO, RISK_WEIGHT, RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY ASSET_TYPE_ONE,ASSET_TYPE_TWO ORDER BY EFF_DATE DESC ) AS rowno FROM RISK_WEIGHT WHERE to_date(#{currentDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= EFF_DATE ) WHERE rowno=1 )weight ON weight.ASSET_TYPE_ONE=T2.TYPE_8 AND weight.ASSET_TYPE_TWO=T2.TYPE_6 where PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.CDATE = to_date(#{currentDate},'yyyy-MM-dd')

SELECT SEQNO seqno, CREDIT_INFO_TYPE creditInfoType, CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE creditQuoteTypeCode, CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE creditQuoteTypeValue, CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK creditQuoteRank FROM CREDIT_MST_INFO where CREDIT_INFO_TYPE = '04'

select SD.INSTITUTION_CODE from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO MCI left join SYS_DEPARTMENT SD on MCI.CREATE_DEPT = SD.DEPT_CODE WHERE 1=1
AND MCI.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
